title: Console & Mgmt IP
lesson: Out-of-band console is how you recover switches when the network is down. Set a management IP in the correct subnet before you rely on SSH.
brief: Attach Console TTY1 to ToR CON, then set Gi1/0/1 management addressing to 10.10.10.2/24 (gateway 10.10.10.1).
constraints: Host IP must be valid in /24 (not .0 or .255)
